name: Dangaronpa Echoes Of The Forgotten Peak
source:
In a place that shouldn't exist—the Forgotten Peak—sixteen students with ultimate talents wake up with no answers. Monokuma offers them the usual rules: trust, suspect... and kill. Only one path ends in freedom. The others, in silence. Akira is the one who holds the gaze when the group begins to break up.

[Translated from [url=https://takaproduccion.itch.io/dangaronpaechoespeak]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一处本不该存在于世的地方——“遗忘之峰”，十六名拥有“超高校级”才能的学生在毫无头绪中苏醒过来。黑白熊向他们抛出了老一套规则：信任、猜忌……以及杀戮。唯有一条道路通往自由，其余皆归于死寂。而当团队开始分崩离析之际，唯有明依然坚定地注视着一切。

[译自[url=https://takaproduccion.itch.io/dangaronpaechoespeak]itch.io[/url]]
